meta.name: claude-plugins-guide
meta.description: This skill should be loaded when creating a plugin, modifying a Claude Code plugin manifest (.claude-plugin/plugin.json), registering a plugin in the Claude marketplace, or adding skills or agents to a plugin. Defines Claude Code marketplace registration and plugin conventions for this repository.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建插件,添加技能,注册到Claude市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为Claude Code开发插件或向市场发布技能。
copy.tagline_en: Create plugins, add skills, and register them in Claude marketplace
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build Claude Code plugins or publish skills to its marketplace.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按官方规范引导你写插件清单:指出必填与可选字段、组件目录的默认位置、依赖的版本规则,以及 marketplace 注册要求。
howto.when: 当你创建插件、修改 .claude-plugin/plugin.json、在 marketplace 注册插件,或向插件添加 skills/agents 时触发。

say.text: 审查我的 plugin.json,列出缺的必填字段
say.note: Claude 会对照规范逐项检查。

say.text: 插件的技能和钩子文件应该放在哪些目录?
say.note: Claude 会告诉你默认发现路径。

say.text: 帮我在 marketplace.json 注册一个插件条目
say.note: 会生成带 name 和 source 的注册项。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude follows the official spec when you work on plugins: it explains required and optional manifest fields, default component paths, dependency version rules, and marketplace registration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating a plugin, editing .claude-plugin/plugin.json, registering in a marketplace, or adding skills/agents to a plugin.

say_en.text: Review my plugin.json and list missing required fields
Where should my plugin's skills and hooks live?
say_en.note: Claude lists the default discovery paths.

say_en.text: Register a plugin entry in marketplace.json for me
say_en.note: Generates an entry with name and source.
